title: sfactory.config.json
description: Configuration for the sfactory pipeline, committed in the adopting repository's root.

$schema.description: URL of this schema, for editor completion.

project.description: The project's name, shown on the board and used to keep two projects' state apart on one machine.

mode.description: Which agents the factory uses: claude only, codex only, or both.

claude.description: Model and effort per role for Claude.

plan.description: Model and effort that write briefs and plans.

review.description: Model and effort that review work.

judge.description: Model and effort that judge disputed findings.

triage.description: Model that sorts and summarises cheaply.

codex.description: Codex profile names per role. Each is a file ~/.codex/<name>.config.toml (or under $CODEX_HOME), layered on by --profile; not a table in ~/.codex/config.toml.

stateDir.description: Where the factory keeps its state; relative to the repo root unless absolute, default .sfactory.

worktrees.description: How worktrees are placed and cut.

dir.description: Directory holding the worktrees; default a sibling of the repo named <repo>-worktrees.

branchPrefix.description: Prefix of every branch the factory creates, default feature/.

baseRule.description: What a new branch is cut from: newest-feature-branch, integration-branch or a branch name.

integrationBranch.description: The integration branch name, used by the integration-branch rule.

afterCut.description: Commands run in a fresh worktree after it is cut.

copyFromBase.description: Untracked files copied from the base checkout into a fresh worktree at the cut. A path listed in secrets.neverHandToAgents is refused (SECRET_PATH): agents work in the worktree from planning on; list such a file in copyForVerify instead.

copyForVerify.description: Untracked files (an .env, say) the verify stage's services need: copied into the card's worktree by services up, from the base branch's checkout or else the main checkout, and removed by services down, job stop and worktree remove.

suite.description: The command that runs the full test suite.

suiteSerial.description: Whether only one suite run may be live at a time, default true.

migrate.description: The command that applies migrations, or null.

services.description: Services started for a live verification run.

port.description: The name of the port it listens on, from ports.names.

env.description: Environment for the service; {port.<name>} is substituted.

live.description: Whether the service is only started for live runs.

step.description: Gap between one job's block of ports and the next.

names.description: Names of the ports each job gets, in order.

record.description: Where the written record of each job lives.

style.description: Layout of the record: one folder per job, or a spec tree.

log.description: Path template of a decisions log.

stories.description: Glob of product stories files, or null.

carriedForward.description: Path of the carried-forward obligations file, or null.

postCloseHeading.description: Heading under which post-close work is appended to a log.

numbering.description: How a milestone's number is chosen, e.g. job-id or next-milestone-number. A fix card never takes one.

fix.description: A fix card's own record patterns ({id} and {slug}, never {n}), relative to the worktree. Without them a fix card's brief and plan are plan/brief.md and plan/plan.md in its job folder, and its log is log.md there, unless it was filed with --log <n>: then milestone n's log, under record.postCloseHeading.

brief.description: Path pattern of a fix card's brief.

plan.description: Path pattern of a fix card's plan.

log.description: Path pattern of a fix card's log, used when it was filed without --log.

rules.description: Files every agent reads before working.

hotspots.description: Paths where parallel branches tend to conflict and changes are kept small.

migrations.description: Where database migrations live, or null when there are none.

dir.description: Migrations directory, relative to the repo root unless absolute.

appliedTo.description: A note on which database the migrations are applied to.

fixCardRefusals.description: Globs a fix card is refused from touching.

stops.description: Stages at which the pipeline stops and waits for a person.

parallelTasks.description: Tasks worked at once within a milestone.

fixRounds.description: Fix rounds allowed after a review.

suiteWaitMs.description: Longest wait, in milliseconds, for the suite lock.

lockStaleMs.description: Age, in milliseconds, after which a lock is treated as stale.

namedPathsOnly.description: Whether commits stage named paths only.

merge.description: The factory never merges; this must be false or absent.

neverHandToAgents.description: Files whose contents are never given to an agent.

pollMs.description: How often the board refreshes, in milliseconds.

activeMs.description: A job in a working stage whose last update is within this many milliseconds shows a live pulse on the board. Default 120000.

prices.description: USD per million tokens by model id, overriding the built-in estimates for the board's cost figure.
